title: Create Aeronautics Discovery
description: An extension for the Minecraft Create Aeronautics to add generated structures to the world.
body:
![Mod Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9fc16ee7f8756ab33b73b589b4361fb6115b9920.png)


Welcome to Create Aeronautics: Discovery

This mod is an extension of the Create Aeronautics and will procedurally generate airships, dynamic flying events, and a new sky trader mob!

# Features

## Worldgen

![A world generated assembled hot air balloon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c8406c91d5281bf549e689c2c5e9c1e4c9324543_0.webp)

Hot air balloon and other flying structures generate naturally across the Overworld. They will be assembled and become physics structures as soon as the player gets in range.

## Flying Events

![A natural spawning assembled airplane](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78b90334041eafb04c81034975fd589b48cd081f_0.webp)

![A plane passing by](https://i.imgur.com/3PlOL7L.gif)

Periodically, an airplane full of loot piloted by a Soaring Trader cruises through the sky near you. It spawn at high altitude and it's quite fast, try to catch it if you can!

![Floating Barrel loot dropped from a plane](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/53bba27d5f2a68bdf9d267dfd0e8798684751842_0.webp)

_Falling Barrels_: Watch out for loot crates falling out of the sky! If a flyover collides with something, the barrels it carries can fall out of it.

## Interaction with the  world

The structures will explode if they detect an impact! 

![flyover-impact](https://i.imgur.com/UAEIIrv.gif)

Some blocks can also explode if shot with an arrow

![balloon-exploding](https://i.imgur.com/0YfcGjt.gif)

All explosions can be disabled from the config

### Soaring Trader
![Soaring Trader](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d50187c43460dd8c5b97cf2a463c24df1fe7329c.png)

A Wandering Trader variant that autonomously pilots the airplane, it trades emerald for a variety of simple Create items and brand new maps to explore rare structures in the world.

## Custom Loot

New loot tables containing a mix of vanilla, Create and Create Aeronautics items.

### Planned features

A big variety of structures are planned to be added in the future, such as _sky dungeons_ and _ship sailing the seas_. New interactions are planned for the existing planes, such as _increased prices for trades_ that come from Soaring Traders that have crashed down and _toggable explotions_ for the planes.

### Commands (OP)

`/spawnprefab [pos] [structure]` Spawn any NBT prefab as a physics-enabled airship

`/discovery flyover toggle` Toggle automatic flying events

`/discovery flyover` Triggers a flying event manually

`/discovery cleanchildsl` Removes all stray barrels originating from flyovers from the world.

You can locate any mod's world generated structure (such as the hot hair balloon) by using the vanila command `/locate structure aeronauticsdiscovery:[namestructure]`

### Configurations

You can configure:

*   Lifetime flying events
*   Frequency flying events
*   Size area reserved to 1 flyover spawn at the time
*   Max Travel distance of flyover before depsawn
*   Obstacle Avoidance: Toggle whether flyovers check for clear paths before spawning

***

## Dependencies

**Required:**

*   Create
*   Create Aeronautics
*   Sable
